race.comment: SHYSTAR (12) started favourite and showed great determination to hang on after finding the lead a long way from home last start over 1300m at this track. Won't mind an extra 100m today and she should be able to hold that strong form at just the fourth run of the preparation. IMAMANZOR (11) has come from near the tail to just miss the placings in his two runs this prep, the latest over today's course and distance three weeks ago. Needs luck to go his way with a racing pattern like that but he can finish over the top if things pan out. MIDLIFE CRISIS (5) has been thereabouts at three runs this time in work, the latest in a similar race to this when a closing third. Has a terrible gate to contend with but he is very honest and should give a good account. RONNY BEE (6) powered home to get up for second here last start, beaten many of today's key rivals home. Fitter and should be strong late again. KALMANA (9) is up in grade but will race handy and give backers a sight.
